hero.title: One transparent price list
hero.subtitle: Pay as you go with no subscriptions or monthly fees. What you see is exactly what each group is billed.

tables.imageUnit: Per image or per 1M output tokens
tables.unavailable: No prices to show right now

notes.title: Billing notes
notes.unit: Text models are billed per million tokens, with separate prices for input, output and cache reads; image models are billed per image or per million output tokens.
notes.estimate: Per-image prices marked with ≈ are estimated at 1024×1024 (about {tokens} output tokens); actual cost varies with size and quality.
notes.longContext: When the input of a single request exceeds the context threshold of a model, the whole request is billed at the long-context price.
notes.edit: Image-to-image and inpainting also count the tokens of the input image, usually a small share of the total.
notes.currency: All prices are in US dollars. Every ¥1 you top up credits US$1, and usage is charged in US dollars.
notes.editions: Prices on this page are what each group is billed; the Enterprise channel is priced by contract. See how the channels differ on the <link>channels page</link>.

items.q1: Is the price on this page what I actually pay?
items.a1: Yes. The displayed price is what each group is billed, and every charge is itemized in the console.
items.q2: Why do prices differ across channels?
items.a2: Channels come with different capacity quality: Shared runs on capacity shared by many users, Dedicated on our own pool with high availability, low latency and full-strength models, and Enterprise is set up for a single company.
items.q3: Are there subscription fees or minimum spend?
items.a3: No. Usage is deducted from your balance as it happens; there is no monthly fee.
items.q4: Am I charged for failed image requests?
items.a4: Requests that fail upstream are not billed. Successful generations are billed per image or per token.
items.a5: Yes, for the Dedicated and Enterprise channels, though not VAT invoices. Payment by bank transfer isn't supported.
items.q6: How do RMB top-ups convert to balance?
items.a6: Every ¥1 you top up credits US$1, and usage is then charged in US dollars.
